edges.reason: Lime stained glass marks the building entrance doorway; light gray panes are on an interior wall only visible after entering through the lime glass door
A 2-block-high gravel wall physically blocks the only path to the concrete powder storage area; player must mine through it to proceed
The concrete powder area is adjacent to the stone staircase leading to the elevated platform from which the lavafall becomes visible
The cave entrance ladder is at the base of the lavafall cliff; player must locate the lavafall to find the cave access point leading to diamond ore
The furnace for smelting raw_iron is inside the cave accessed at the base of the lavafall; player must find the lavafall area to locate cave entrance
Decorative polished granite stairs are railing elements on the elevated platform; player must reach the platform via the lavafall area to access them
Player must visit the dark oak grove (confirmed by shearing leaves) to obtain oak_log needed for crafting planks and then the pressure plate

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — player must navigate to and observe the lime stained glass building entrance. Target is center of the lime glass wall at (6, 2, 3) spawn-relative. Max_distance set to 6 to prevent trivial triggering from spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~7 blocks, so player must take steps toward the building). Facing_tolerance 60 ensures player is looking at the glass.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — player must enter the glass building and observe the interior light gray stained glass pane divider wall at Z=7. Max_distance 5 ensures player is inside the building (building is 6 blocks deep). Facing_tolerance 60 ensures player faces the panes.

Uses inventory_has because mining gravel drops the gravel block into inventory (90% chance per block; 10% flint). The 2-high gravel wall has 14 blocks total — player must mine at least 2 to create a passage, giving negligible failure probability. Player does not start with any gravel in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — player must pass through the mined gravel wall and locate the yellow concrete powder stack at (5, 1, 16). Max_distance 8 requires player to be well past the gravel wall (at z=12) to reach the concrete powder (at z=15-17). Facing_tolerance 60 ensures player is looking at the powder.

Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_leaves with shears drops the leaf block into inventory. Player is given shears for this purpose. Without shears, leaves drop nothing useful. Player does not start with any dark_oak_leaves. This also confirms the player visited the dark oak grove (prerequisite for oak_pressure_plate crafting).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — player must reach the platform area and observe the lavafall. Target is mid-height of the lava column at (17, 5, 22). Max_distance 10 covers the viewing distance from the platform (platform at x=7-12, lava at x=17, so ~5-10 blocks). Facing_tolerance 60 ensures player is looking toward the lavafall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — player must descend the ladder into the cave and locate the diamond ore blocks at (15, -3, 23). Max_distance 6 ensures player is inside the small cave chamber (3x3x2 blocks). Facing_tolerance 60 ensures player is looking at the ore.

Uses inventory_has because smelting raw_iron in the furnace produces iron_ingot which the player retrieves into inventory. Player starts with raw_iron and coal but NO iron_ingot, so having 1 iron_ingot confirms successful smelting. The furnace is in the cave at (15, -2, 21).

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_granite_stairs with iron pickaxe drops the stair block into inventory. The decorative granite stairs are railing elements on the platform at y=6 (separate from the stone access stairs). Player does not start with any polished_granite_stairs in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_pressure_plate (2 oak_planks in a row) places the result in inventory. Player must first chop oak_log with iron_axe to get oak_planks, then craft the pressure plate. Player starts with NO oak_planks and NO oak_pressure_plate, so having 1 confirms the full craft chain was completed.

task_text: Explore this area systematically: find the glass building and examine its colored panes, mine through the gravel wall to find concrete powder, climb the stairs to spot the lavafall, descend into the cave to find diamond ore and smelt iron, mine decorative granite stairs on the platform, then visit the dark oak grove to craft an oak pressure plate from chopped logs.
